stem.text: Which statement about the ammonia molecule and/or the ammonium ion is correct?

A.text: Ammonia molecules are basic because they can donate $\text{H}^{+}$ ions.

B.text: Ammonium ions are basic because they can accept $\text{H}^{+}$ ions.

C.text: If ammonium ions are heated with $\text{NaOH(aq)}$, ammonia molecules are formed.

D.text: The bond angle in $\text{NH}_4^{+}$ is $2.5^{\circ}$ less than the bond angle in $\text{NH}_3$.
